questions.title: Should the app follow the system theme by default?
context: The app opens in light mode and has a manual dark mode switch in settings.
- Following the system theme means no switch to find on first launch.
- A manual override stays available in settings either way.
**What each option leads to** is under the option.

options.label: Follow the system theme
options.detail: New users see the theme they already chose for their phone. Settings keeps a manual override.

options.label: Keep light mode as the default
options.detail: Nothing changes. Users who prefer dark mode switch it once in settings.
